prompt.text:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: one flak projectile: a hot-casing shrapnel ball, a compact round steel casing with a glowing ember-hot core.

Design identity to keep exactly — a small round explosive shell at the instant of firing: dark steel casing, the rim and burst seams glowing hot amber-orange (#f8b048 glow, #d0501c hot rim, near-black #1a1212 casing), a few tiny spark flecks breaking off, three-to-four step shading lit from the top-left. The classic flak ball of an arcade cannon, 6-pixel-class chunky form enlarged with v2 detail.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- The sheet holds exactly ONE cell — the WHOLE canvas is the single subject's frame; an empty sheet ruins it.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = the flak shell The subject fills the cell as ONE large centred figure, aspect ratio about 1.0:1 (0.7:1 to 1.4:1).
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 1 subject cell — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge

notes: w15-REING7 (gen7 row b-flak): the hot flak casing with its spark flecks breaking off, the 512x512 key-green cell's subject bbox widened 6 px, contain-fit into the 8x8 slot. FLUX.2-dev non-commercial ruling 2026-10-23.
